questionSnapshot.question: In Cinderella (1950), what color is the ball gown when the Fairy Godmother first creates it?
questionSnapshot.explanation: The gown is silver when it first appears; the animators deliberately make it look blue during the moonlit dance.

notes: Fixed the time/context ambiguity, changed correct answer to silver and removed white as a near-synonym. Four short color options. Unlike #188 (Sadness), this is a different film, object and color. Medium visual-detail recall: the silver creation scene is less familiar than the blue promotional appearance.
